text: There was a water leak near Conference Room 2 around 10 AM. Maintenance has already isolated the area.
Small fire in the pantry on the third floor at 2:30 PM, it was minor and the staff put it out with an extinguisher.
A worker slipped near the loading dock this morning at 9, he hurt his leg badly and we called an ambulance.
Sparks coming from the electrical panel behind the cafeteria at 11:45 AM. Electrician has switched off the main supply.
Laptop theft reported in the HR office at 4 PM yesterday. Security has been informed.
Chemical spill in lab 3 around 1 PM, critical, we evacuated the corridor.
The lift on block B is stuck with two people inside at 6:15 PM. Fire department called.
Short circuit in server room at 3 AM. Major outage, IT team is working on it.
Suspicious person near the main gate at 8:30 in the evening.
Pipe burst on the second floor washroom at 7 AM, water everywhere, moderate damage.
One of the guests fainted in the lobby around 5 PM. First aid was given.
There was some smoke in the kitchen.
Printer is not working in the finance department.
Forklift hit a rack in warehouse 2 at 12:10 PM, two workers injured, serious, ambulance called.
Unauthorized access attempt at the data center door at 1:20 AM, guard stopped him.
Uh so basically the AC unit in room 405 started leaking water onto the carpet, housekeeping is on it.
My colleague Ramesh tripped on the stairs near the canteen yesterday evening around 7, nothing serious.
The projector in seminar hall 4 is dead since this morning.
Someone left a bag unattended near platform 2 at 5:40 pm, we have informed the station master.
Oil spilled on the shop floor, two operators slipped but are fine, supervisor cleaned it up at 11.
At about 3:15 this afternoon a projector in Lab 102 started smoking. Ravi unplugged it and we opened the windows.
Twenty minutes ago there was a gas smell in the server room, no wait, the electrical room. Security has cleared the corridor.
Priya from accounts slipped near the cafeteria entrance and hurt her ankle, Ravi saw it. It happened about half an hour ago.
The network is down on the second floor since 9 AM.
Near miss in the parking area, a forklift almost hit a guard at 5 PM yesterday.
